I grow beans because they do not need much money to plant, and I can use seed I kept from last season. Since this plot is rented and small, I will not spend money on fertilizer or chemicals—I need to save what little I have for my maize plot where my family gets most of our food. I will rely on rain and my own hands, with help from my children when they are not in school.
